description: Report one action of this session to the observer. Each report is written first to this session's own log outside the project, then shown live if an observer is running. Never retry a report and never wait on one. The server stamps time, session and order; send only `kind` and that kind's fields. Kinds: `session_started` (first, once per session, called on its own: projectRoot, kanbanTag, brainPath — the brain's folder path when the brain is plain folders) · `prompt` (text: the user's message, in full) · `task` (slug, action picked|moved, title?, column?; `picked` when the session takes up a task, also one already In Progress that nothing moves) · `pipeline_started` (pipeline, phase: the phase it starts or resumes at) · `pipeline_finished` (pipeline, result completed|abandoned) · `phase_skipped` (pipeline, phase, reason; report every skip) · `phase_started` (pipeline, phase, agent, module) · `phase_finished` (pipeline, phase, agent, module, result?, summary?) · `gate_waiting` (pipeline, gate, file: the path of the file awaiting the user's approval) · `gate_resolved` (pipeline, gate, file, resolution?) · `plan_step_checked` (pipeline, module, step, total?) · `qa_verdict` (pipeline, module, verdict passed|issues, open?) · `file_written` (path, action created|updated) · `commit` (sha, message?) · `release` (version) · `error` (message, agent?, module?). A pipeline is one feature flow, named by its kanban task's slug, else a short name kept for the whole flow; hand work outside a pipeline names none. Phase is one of spec, research, synthesize, structure, plan, build, qa, fix, align, refactor, cleanup. The reply is one line ending with `[observer-session <id>]`, this session's id: `recorded`, `recorded; observer not running` (call aide_observer_start once; if that restart answers BLOCKED, stop and tell the user), `refused: session ended` (another session ended this one with the user's approval: stop and tell the user), or why it was not recorded.
name: aide_observer_event
